text.p: -- Furman Selz said it added Xircom Inc to its recommended list. The firm said it raised Xircom to buy from neutral.
-- said believes Xircom is positioned "to capitalize on the strong underlying growth potential in mobile networking."
-- set a 12-month price target of $20 a share.
-- said expects Xircom's revenue will be $58.6 million in the current quarter, which represents 2.5 percent sequential growth and 33 percent year-over-year growth.
-- said expects Xircom to earn $0.18 a share in the current quarter.
-- said expects strong revenue and earnings potential from the recently announced relationship with Intel Corp.
